title: Input and oracle errors in unit tests written by language models: code and data
description: Code, model replies and analysis for a study that separates invalid inputs, wrong expected values and correct assertions in unit tests generated by Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, Gemma3-4B and DeepSeek-V3.2 for 157 HumanEval+ functions, with fault detection on behaviour-changing mutants.
